subject.title: Feature Request: Surface API provider name in error/overload messages

question: Should the accepted fix for this issue show only provider/model context, or also broader context such as profile presence and trigger in user-facing overload/rate-limit messages?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the linked PR expands the visible diagnostic surface beyond the original provider-name request, which needs a maintainer privacy and UX boundary before merge.

options.title: Prefer provider/model-only copy
options.body: Land a narrow fix that includes the failed provider/model in overload and rate-limit copy while keeping profile, session, trigger, and request identifiers out of chat-visible text.

options.title: Accept broader diagnostic context
options.body: Approve the linked PR's broader profile-presence and trigger context if maintainers want that extra operator signal in visible replies and are satisfied with its redaction boundary.

options.title: Pause until UX boundary is set
options.body: Keep the issue open without landing a fix until maintainers decide exactly which transient-error metadata belongs in channel-visible messages.

recommendation.title: Prefer provider/model-only copy
recommendation.body: Land a narrow fix that includes the failed provider/model in overload and rate-limit copy while keeping profile, session, trigger, and request identifiers out of chat-visible text.
